# Test fixtures

Only small, redistributable synthetic fixtures may be committed here. Do not commit copyrighted books, real voice samples without permission, or generated full-length audio.

## EPUB spike fixtures

The `epub/synthetic-*` source trees contain original synthetic text created for this project and
dedicated for unrestricted test use. They cover complex semantics, malformed story/navigation
XML, missing navigation, valid NCX-only EPUB 2, and adversarial nested passage ownership. Their
`.epub` siblings are deterministic archives generated by:

```sh
pnpm --filter @light-novel-audiobook/epub-spike build:fixtures
```

The fixture story, names, metadata, SVG, and UUID are fictional and are not excerpts from a book.
